category_title: Students who engage in gossiping and bystander behavior
scenario_title: Managing gossip and bystander behavior during group projects
minimal_context: The student is working on a group project with friends in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please start working on your group project with Jill.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay. Hey Jill, did you hear what the other group was doing? I heard they...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should be doing right now?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Right, sorry. Me and Jill have been working together on that and like when I start saying something then we will remind each other to not say that.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to focus on the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have been trying to do a lot better on that gossiping and it’s really hard, but it’s just a work in progress I guess. It's just really hard to stop when everyone else is talking.
